78439.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Why Strategy sold bitcoin at $60K just to buy it back at $80K
78439.body:
G20 finance leaders vow to establish 'clear pathways' for digital assets innovation | Kalshi and Polymarket's combined volume falls 15% in August, first monthly decline in a year | Adam Back invests another $8.8 million in Capital B as bitcoin treasury firm targets 3,521 BTC | Hyperliquid Strategies expands equity facility to $2.5 billion |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Wednesday! *Bitcoin* is holding near $77,000 despite surging global bond yields and renewed U.S.-Iran tensions, with analysts ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-02-bitcoin-hovers-near-77000-as-global-bond-selloff-tests-post-rally-resilience-413320?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) pointing to light leverage and strong ETF demand as signs of resilience after August's 25% rally.

In today's newsletter, *Strategy* CEO *Phong Le* explains why the firm sold *bitcoin* low and bought it high, *G20* finance leaders agree to establish clearer rules for digital assets, *Kalshi* and *Polymarket* see their monthly volumes drop for the first time in a year, and more.

Meanwhile, buying memecoins with credit cards on *Robinhood Wallet* and *Fomo* appears to sidestep card-network crypto rules, Zack Abrams reports ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-01-buying-memecoins-with-credit-cards-on-robinhood-wallet-fomo-sidestep-card-network-crypto-rules-411911?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) in The Block's latest feature ( https://www.theblock.co/features?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) piece.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Le's comments* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*👀 Strategy CEO says selling bitcoin at $60,000 before buying at $80,000 was the 'right trade'*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-02-strategy-ceo-says-selling-bitcoin-at-60000-before-buying-at-80000-was-the-right-trade-413323?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Strategy* CEO *Phong Le* defended selling roughly 7,000 BTC in the $60,000 to $65,000 range before buying back around $80,000, saying the decisions were driven by capital costs rather than *bitcoin's* price.

* "It was the right trade at the time to sell bitcoin to fund some of our *Stretch* dividends," Le said in a Bloomberg TV interview. "It's the right trade at this point in time to sell *MSTR* at a premium to buy bitcoin."

_**Your Weekly Deep Dive into The World of Crypto**_

**September 2, 2026 · ****5 Min Read**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/20b98eb5-d7d6-45ff-ae07-09ef7cf8db82/image.png?t=1788327101)
Caption: _As of September 2, 2026, morning ET  |  Sources: Coinglass, Alternative.me, SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

Bitcoin tagged $81,347 intraday on Aug 28 (per Coinglass), then Fed Chair Warsh spoke at Jackson Hole, and the tape reversed within an hour. BTC settled the week near $77,700, and a nine-day spot BTC ETF inflow streak snapped with a $201.81M outflow.

But money did not leave crypto. ETH ETFs took their best week. BitMine bought another $131M of ETH. And a Trump-branded memecoin rugged nearly 98% in an afternoon. 

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. BitMine Almost Owns 5% of Ethereum**

On Aug 31, Tom Lee’s BitMine[ reported](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/bitmine-immersion-technologies-bmnr-announces-eth-holdings-reach-5-90-million-tokens-and-total-crypto-and-total-cash-holdings-of-15-6-billion-302864579.html) another 53,501 ETH bought in the week ending Aug 30, its 65th straight weekly purchase since June 2025. The stack now sits at 5,901,112 ETH, about 4.9% of supply. Total holdings including cash: $15.6B. 5.07M ETH is staked, projected to earn $335M annualized (Source:[ PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/bitmine-immersion-technologies-bmnr-announces-eth-holdings-reach-5-90-million-tokens-and-total-crypto-and-total-cash-holdings-of-15-6-billion-302864579.html)).

_**BitMine is 133,900 ETH from its 5% target.**_

**Whale Intel: **When one entity owns 5% of an asset and keeps buying every week for over a year, it stops being a trade and starts being infrastructure.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5b22409e-8b95-4843-be59-200b70dca0bd/image.jpeg?t=1788327155)
Caption: BitMine treasury snapshot  |  Source: BitMine press release, Aug 31, 2026

### **2. Strive Cracks the Corporate BTC Top 5**

Vivek Ramaswamy’s Strive (NASDAQ: ASST) picked up[ 1,800 BTC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1920406/000162828026059468/asst-20260831.htm) for roughly $143M this week, taking total holdings to 23,156 BTC and passing Bullish for the No. 5 spot among public corporate holders. Strive keeps issuing ASST common and SATA preferred to fund the buys. Shares jumped 5% on the news, even after a[ $257.6M Q2 net loss](https://news.alphastreet.com/strive-releases-q2-2026-financial-results/) tied to BTC’s drop.

78407.subject: AVALANCHE AUGUST 2026 RECAP
78407.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-august-2026-recap

August was the month Wall Street started showing up on Avalanche in earnest. Charles Schwab added AVAX for its 40 million brokerage accounts, Dinari brought 724 tokenized U.S. stocks including the full S&P 500 to Avalanche investors, and POSCO International completed a proof of concept for tokenizing global trade receivables on the network.
At the same time, Team1 officially launched in Korea. With Avalanche Summit NYC less than three weeks away, September is shaping up to be a major moment for the ecosystem.
Here’s everything that happened in August.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Tokenized Assets Grow Nearly 8x in a Year:
Tokenized assets on Avalanche climbed from $242 million to $1.93 billion over the past year, with Securitize now accounting for more than half of that value. [Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/5fc6043c-d884-4242-90b9-611b3d9b8308?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Foundation Introduces Gross Chain Income:
The Avalanche Foundation published a new Gross Chain Income framework from Lead Economist Eric Lu, extending its Gross Chain Product work into a three-step model for measuring, capturing, and distributing value across the ecosystem. [GCI [ https://substack.com/redirect/92d16235-ee07-40f6-a010-1a719e9a302b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
RWA Transfer Volume Jumps 360% in 30 Days:
Avalanche’s RWA ecosystem recorded $365.29 million in 30-day transfer volume, up 360.15% from the prior month, spanning tokenized funds, equities, treasuries, and private credit. [Volume [ https://substack.com/redirect/183ebb6c-4c8e-4af8-ad57-0c24db4d6fce?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Korea Officially Launches:
Team1 Korea launched after onboarding more than 500 builders, 12 teams, 200-plus developers, and 80-plus founders, giving Korean talent a clearer path to build on Avalanche.
Team1 Chapters Stay Busy Across Five Continents:
Team1 chapters continued bringing Avalanche directly to local builders. August highlights included a builder workshop in Seoul focused on AI-agent payments, a meetup in Reggio Calabria, a Builder Connect at Oracle’s Bogotá offices, an L1 workshop in Türkiye, university activity in Vietnam, and multiple builder and community events across Brazil, India, Latin America, Nigeria and lots more.
New paths for funding and support opened up this month.
Team1 Opens Applications for ProtocolCamp Cohort 10:
Team1 called for builders to join ProtocolCamp Cohort 10, a 12-week program turning ideas into shipped products with travel covered and a kickoff during Korea Blockchain Week. [ProtocolCamp [ https://substack.com/redirect/484aea27-85f1-40c0-922a-43f8706045a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEW
